note: Every move is an entry. cost is stamina. damage is scaled by the user's Power over 10 and by the type chart. guard is the share of each hit that still lands. restore is stamina back. shield blocks that much damage this turn. bonus adds per x a counter and spends it. phases cycle each use.

guard.name: Guard
guard.detail: Hits this turn land at a quarter. 2 stamina back.

comfort_blanket.name: Comfort blanket
comfort_blanket.detail: 8 damage and a 12 point shield this turn.

salvage_charge.name: Salvage charge
salvage_charge.detail: 13 damage, plus 6 for each stored charge. Blocking a hit stores a charge (up to 2).

orbit.name: Orbit
orbit.detail: Takes turns: 18 damage, then 12 damage with an 8 point shield.

banked_heat.name: Banked heat
banked_heat.detail: 14 damage. After a Recover, the stored heat makes it 26.
